name: HG930 (Double Sided Version)
tagline: Expansive double-sided fire view with architectural wide-format storage
description: The HG930 (Double Sided Version) is a grand, wide-format tunnel wood stove engineered to stand as a stunning architectural centerpiece between connecting rooms. Weighing a substantial 185kg, it offers magnificent dual-aspect viewing through its wide front and rear panoramic glass windows. The unit is integrated onto an extra-wide, open low plinth that serves as a highly functional, built-in log storage solution, providing exceptional thermal mass and an elegant layout divider.
features: Substantial 185kg heavy-duty construction for immense thermal performance
Double-sided fire box configuration offering an ultra-wide tunnel view of the flames
Extra-wide integrated lower open base designed for clean and expansive log storage
Dual-sliding air intake controls on the front trim for balanced precision combustion
Large-diameter top flue outlet optimized for superior airflow in wide-format stoves
